title: Durante Park, Longboat Key, Florida, USA - Durante Park Red-winged Blackbird
author: Pierrot Desperes
notes: One complete 'konk-la-ree' song: short intro notes ~1.4-2.2 kHz then the buzzy trill 2.5-6 kHz, natural tail kept, clean gaps both sides. Quiet source (peak ~-34 dBFS) with low-frequency rumble below ~250 Hz and a distant dove at ~500 Hz elsewhere in the file - the hp removes both; normalise. Stereo source, use as mono (L+R). Recorded Durante Park, Longboat Key (Manatee/Sarasota), Florida, 2021-03

title: XC1133697 Red-winged Blackbird
author: Rory Nefdt
notes: Complete song from a different male (Florida Keys): rising intro notes ~1.2-1.5 kHz, then the 2-5.5 kHz trill ending in a ~2 kHz whistle. Strong wind/traffic-like rumble below ~250 Hz in the source - the hp is required. The male's short 'check' calls elsewhere in the file are outside the cut. Recorded John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park, Key Largo, Monroe County, Florida, 2026-04-28 15:00. In-ban

title: XC196268 Red-winged Blackbird
author: Paul Marvin
notes: Complete loud song from a third male (on a small mangrove in coastal marsh). A steady summer insect band at ~6-9 kHz runs under the whole file about 35 dB below the song; fits the scene but will be audible if the clip is played very loud. Recorded Black Point Wildlife Drive, Merritt Island NWR, Brevard Co., Florida, 2014-06-19 10:52. In-band SNR ~33 dB; lowest note ~1477 Hz.

title: XC1133697 Red-winged Blackbird
author: Rory Nefdt
notes: Second rendition from the Key Largo male (same song type as -2, different take); the neighbouring 'check' calls fall outside the cut. hp required for the low rumble. Recorded John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park, Key Largo, Monroe County, Florida, 2026-04-28 15:00. In-band SNR ~35 dB; lowest note ~1336 Hz.

title: XC705391 Boat-tailed Grackle
author: Paul Driver
notes: Series of 6 sharp down-slurred 'jeeb/clack' notes (4 -> 1.7 kHz) - the loud metallic clacks. Steady insect lines at ~4 and ~5.5 kHz under the whole file, ~40 dB below the notes. Recorded at Ochopee in Big Cypress. Recorded Ochopee (Big Cypress), Collier County, Florida, 2022-02-25 06:45. In-band SNR ~36 dB; lowest note ~1594 Hz.

title: XC109025 Boat-tailed Grackle
author: Andrew Spencer
notes: Harsh rattle: an accelerating series of ~12 dry, noisy notes (1.5-12 kHz) ending in one loud 'clack', from a male perched in a pine at a marsh edge; starts from silence and ends in the quiet after the last note (+45 dB). Faint insect lines at ~5 and ~9 kHz ~45 dB down. Recorded Emeralda Marsh Conservation Area, Lake Co., Florida, 2012-05-22 11:15. In-band SNR ~44 dB; lowest note ~2344 Hz.

title: XC109025 Boat-tailed Grackle
author: Andrew Spencer
notes: Series of 5 loud harmonic 'chuck/clack' notes (fundamental ~3 kHz, harmonics to 12 kHz) from a different male perched in a pine at a marsh edge; very clean (+50 dB). Faint insect lines at ~5 and ~9 kHz, ~45 dB down. Recorded Emeralda Marsh Conservation Area, Lake Co., Florida, 2012-05-22 11:15. In-band SNR ~49 dB; lowest note ~2801 Hz.

title: XC109025 Boat-tailed Grackle
author: Andrew Spencer
notes: Complete display song of the same male as -3: low whistles (~1-1.3 kHz) and a buzzy harmonic note, a short pause, then the dry rattle of ~8 noisy notes ending in a sharp up-swept 'jeeb', natural tail. Near the 8 s limit; whistles are the lowest notes, hence the lower hp. Recorded Emeralda Marsh Conservation Area, Lake Co., Florida, 2012-05-22 11:15. In-band SNR ~43 dB; lowest note ~2238 Hz.

title: XC712983 Limpkin
author: Bruce Lagerquist
notes: One classic wailing 'kree-ow' scream: arched harmonic call (fundamental ~1 -> 1.6 -> 0.9 kHz, harmonics to ~15 kHz), loud and close, tail kept up to the next call. Pro-quality 320k stereo source (used mono). Several other calls in this file clip at 0 dBFS - this one does not. Recorded Fort Drum Marsh, Indian River County, Florida, 2022-03-05 16:38. In-band SNR ~37 dB; lowest note ~867 Hz.

title: XC712983 Limpkin
author: Bruce Lagerquist
notes: Two consecutive 'kree-ow' screams from the same bird as -1 (unclipped part of the file), starting and ending in the gaps between calls. Recorded Fort Drum Marsh, Indian River County, Florida, 2022-03-05 16:38. In-band SNR ~33 dB; lowest note ~855 Hz.

title: XC331321 Limpkin
author: Sue Riffe
notes: Single clean arched 'kree-ow' from a different bird in the Loxahatchee cypress swamp (northern Everglades). A steady broadband wash (250 Hz-1.5 kHz, probably distant road noise) sits ~30 dB below the call; the hp reduces it but it remains faintly at the clip edges - give 50 ms fades. Recorded Loxahatchee NWR (cypress swamp boardwalk), Palm Beach County, Florida, 2016-04-26 17:12. In-band SNR ~33 d

title: XC426300 Limpkin
author: Phil Brown
notes: Two harsh, raspy screams from a pair calling back and forth (Collier County, near Big Cypress): very loud and close with a long reverberant swamp tail (+45 dB, clean gaps). Rougher/noisier timbre than -1..-3 (possibly slight recorder overload); recordist already high-passed at ~420 Hz. Recorded Naples, Collier County, Florida, 2017-12-24 10:00. In-band SNR ~45 dB; lowest note ~551 Hz.

title: XC316293 Sandhill Crane
author: Sue Riffe
notes: Florida pair's unison call in Everglades NP (wet prairie by Mahogany Hammock): continuous rolling 'garoo-a-a' rattles ~600-1000 Hz with harmonics, ending into silence. Low wind/handling blobs (<300 Hz) in the source: the two big ones (0.9 s, 2.8 s) are outside the cut, two small ones remain ~25 dB below the calls - the hp is required (24 dB/oct if available). Quieter and more distant than -2/-3. R

title: XC268517 Sandhill Crane
author: Paul Marvin
notes: Three rolling bugles ('garooo', fundamental ~850-950 Hz with harmonics to 10 kHz) from a pair calling in unison while walking away across ranch grassland; clean gaps, +40 dB. Faint steady insect tone at ~8.5 kHz ~45 dB down. Recorded River Lakes Conservation Area near Viera, Brevard Co., Florida, 2015-08-15 09:37. In-band SNR ~33 dB; lowest note ~516 Hz.

title: XC268517 Sandhill Crane
author: Paul Marvin
notes: Two of the loudest bugles of the same pair (later in the bout, +41-43 dB), cut in the gaps with natural tails. Recorded River Lakes Conservation Area near Viera, Brevard Co., Florida, 2015-08-15 09:37. In-band SNR ~38 dB; lowest note ~527 Hz.

title: XC109041 Sandhill Crane
author: Andrew Spencer
notes: Flight calls: three rolling bugles from a trio flying overhead (0.6-2 kHz), cut from gap to gap. A steady insect band ~4-5 kHz and some low wind noise in the source (hp removes the wind; the insect band is ~30 dB down). Recorded Emeralda Marsh Conservation Area, Lake Co., Florida, 2012-05-22 06:50. In-band SNR ~27 dB; lowest note ~469 Hz.

title: XC167213 Great Egret
author: Paul Marvin
notes: One loud harsh 'kraak' croak (harmonic stack ~0.6-5 kHz) as a pair took flight in Everglades NP; +41 dB, clean before/after. Faint insect tone at ~5.8 kHz. Recorded Gumbo Limbo Trail, Everglades National Park, Florida, 2014-02-06 11:17. In-band SNR ~39 dB; lowest note ~621 Hz.

title: XC167213 Great Egret
author: Paul Marvin
notes: Another croak from the same flushed pair (different shape, rising-falling), +40 dB, ending in the gap before the next croak. Recorded Gumbo Limbo Trail, Everglades National Park, Florida, 2014-02-06 11:17. In-band SNR ~35 dB; lowest note ~504 Hz.

title: XC161276 Great Egret
author: Paul Marvin
notes: Single croak (harmonics from ~0.9 kHz) from an egret in a crowded feeding flock at Viera Wetlands - different bird/site. Background flock murmur 250 Hz-1.5 kHz is ~30 dB below the croak; recordist high-passed at ~280 Hz. Recorded Viera Wetlands, Brevard Co., Florida, 2013-11-19 08:31. In-band SNR ~30 dB; lowest note ~879 Hz.

title: XC225658 Western Osprey
author: Paul Marvin
notes: Three whistled 'cheep' notes (sharp attack, slurred ~2.5-3 kHz whistle with harmonic at ~5.5 kHz) from a perched osprey at Flamingo, Everglades NP. Very clean (+50 dB), cut in the gap before the next note. Recorded Flamingo, Everglades National Park, Florida, 2014-05-23 08:11. In-band SNR ~50 dB; lowest note ~2004 Hz.

title: XC225658 Western Osprey
author: Paul Marvin
notes: Excited, faster chirp series from the same bird (more complex, rising/falling chirps) ending the bout; clean tail. Recorded Flamingo, Everglades National Park, Florida, 2014-05-23 08:11. In-band SNR ~44 dB; lowest note ~2039 Hz.

title: XC758691 Western Osprey
author: Bruce Lagerquist
notes: Rapid series of whistled chirps from a different osprey perched on a snag (Sound Devices MixPre-3 + ME67, lossless source); faint calls of two birds circling above add depth. Source has a 500 Hz-1.5 kHz wash ~45 dB down - hp 1500. Recorded Wabasso Scrub Conservation Area, Indian River County, Florida, 2022-03-31 10:23. In-band SNR ~41 dB; lowest note ~1934 Hz.

title: XC758691 Western Osprey
author: Bruce Lagerquist
notes: Slower, spaced chirps from the same perched bird as -3 (distinct phrasing), clean gaps; avoid the loud early part of this file, which clips. Recorded Wabasso Scrub Conservation Area, Indian River County, Florida, 2022-03-31 10:23. In-band SNR ~42 dB; lowest note ~1816 Hz.
